stem.text: A skydiver jumps from an aeroplane and falls vertically through the air.
Which graph shows the variation with time $t$ of the skydiver’s vertical velocity $v$?

A.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis. A straight line rises from the origin.

B.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis. A straight line falls from the top of the vertical axis to the horizontal axis.

C.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis. A curve rises from the origin and levels off towards the top right.

D.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis. A curve rises slowly from the origin and then steeply towards the top right.
